summary: {person} asks which parts of a route change will end when road construction finishes.
realLife: Milwaukee’s March notice separated permanent route shortenings under its service plan from long-term construction detours and traffic-related timetable adjustments.
gates: A budget change and a construction detour affect the same network.
weights: Concurrent changes on a single route make public notices harder to interpret.
inGame: needs: budget change, construction order, affected segment and duration.

turns.what: Staff remove the temporary detour from the map.
turns.writesBack: Retain the separately adopted route shortening.

turns.what: Staff revise the detour end date.
turns.writesBack: Leave the budget decision and its effective date intact.
